<soCalled>

<soCalled> (so called) contains a word or phrase for which the author or narrator indicates a disclaiming of responsibility, for example by the use of scare quotes or italics.
Attributes Global attributes and those inherited from hqphrase
Example 
To edge his way along the crowded paths of life, warning
all human sympathy to keep its distance, was what the
knowing ones call <soCalled>nuts</soCalled> to Scrooge.
Module Declared in file teicore2; Core tag sets: enabled when any TEI base is enabled
Class hqphrase
